# langweave-plugins

<!-- generated by pack:skill — do not edit -->

Weaves a target language into the model's replies, at the level this user can actually read.

This repository is the public packaging of that, and nothing else: marketplace manifests and
one skill, all of them pointing at the hosted MCP server.

## Install

**Claude Code**

```
/plugin marketplace add Jesusdiazrivero/langweave-plugins
/plugin install langweave@langweave
```

**Any client that takes a remote MCP URL** — Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Le Chat, Gemini CLI:

```
https://api.langweave.tech/mcp
```

You will be asked to sign in, and then to choose a target language at https://app.langweave.tech. Until you do,
every tool answers with the same message saying so — the language you will spend a year learning
is an account decision, not one the model makes for you.

Full guide: https://docs.langweave.tech/connect/plugin/

## Nothing here is edited by hand

Every file in this repository is generated by `pack:skill` in the langweave source repository
and pushed here by CI on a release tag. **Pull requests against generated paths are not
accepted** — that is every path in this repository. The behavioural contract in
`skills/language-mode/SKILL.md` is golden-file tested at its source, and a change here would
be silently overwritten by the next release.

Found a problem with the wording? Open an issue. It gets fixed upstream and arrives here on
the next push.

| Path | For |
